question: Submission description (a short paragraph)
answer: Segment-level quality scoring (ESA-style 0-100 score) combining Gemini 3.5 Flash (closed-weight), Gemma 4 12B (open-weight, Phrase-served via local vLLM), and UFAL cat-v4 (Charles University's two-stage MQM-style error detector, based on open-weight Gemma 4 31B with 4-bit AWQ quantization, few-shot prompting and one-pass self-refinement), via a scalar mean of each system's own score weighted by a per-system reliability prior (each system's standalone Pearson correlation on held-out WMT25 dev data), with a Gemini+Gemma-only fallback for segments UFAL did not cover.
